notes.title: Release Day!
notes.content:
Nano Nebula is released today! Please enjoy the game.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32796388/1da504b5fbd93eabd350d5d489505df57a7d3b62.png

If you discover a bug or issue, please post in the "Bug Reports / Issues" thread on the community hub, and it will be fixed as soon as possible.
